_comment: Archetype classifier config. Copy to config.json and edit paths. Override the location with the ARCHETYPE_CONFIG_PATH env var.
_classifier_url: Preferred transport: base URL of the archetype classifier Cloud Run service (see archetype_server/). When set (or via env ARCHETYPE_CLASSIFIER_URL), the backend POSTs batches over HTTP and needs no local torch. Leave empty to use the legacy local subprocess worker below.
_classifier_api_key: Optional shared secret; sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Must match CLASSIFIER_API_KEY on the service. Env override: ARCHETYPE_CLASSIFIER_API_KEY.
_python_executable: Legacy local-subprocess transport only. Interpreter of the dedicated conda env that has torch+transformers+safetensors. Ignored when classifier_url is set.
_script_path: Path to classify_retrieved_papers.py. Relative paths resolve relative to the workspace/project root.
_checkpoint_dir: Fine-tuned checkpoint dir. Relative paths resolve relative to the workspace/project root.
_label_mapping_path: label_mapping.json path. Relative paths resolve relative to the workspace/project root.
_encoder_config: Static BERT/SciBERT architecture used to rebuild the encoder offline (weights come from the checkpoint).
